_about: The one size rule for on-screen type (the owner, 2026-10-05: numbers 'the perfect size - not big, not small'; text bold and clean). Each share is the height of the CAPITALS (= the digits) as a share of the FRAME HEIGHT; the font size is share x height / the face's cap height. Read by components/lib/typeKit.tsx and by the worker's tests (tests/test_type_system.py), so the rule has one home.
_dates: The date family (the owner, 2026-10-06: 'when dates are mentioned it barely shows them ... a PERFECT SIZE - not big, not small'): the main date line is a headline (capitals 6 % of the height = a font of 8.2 % of the height, 89 px at 1080p), its kicker 2.5 % (font), the whole block 17-30 % of the frame width, never a full-screen takeover. components/lib/LibKtDates.tsx; tests/test_dates_v2.py checks the numbers.
_rings: A share's ring and a multiplier's ring (the owner, 2026-10-06: 'perfect ones, not full-screen ones'): the diameter 18 % of the frame height (16-20 %), the number inside it, one line of context beside it.
